breaking.member: Select list and group CSS boxes
breaking.change: Select lists, suggestion lists and group headings have persistent CSS layout and paint boxes. List border widths participate in layout; the default frames remain unchanged.
breaking.fix: Style list interiors through select::part(list) and headings through select::part(group). The popup host still owns its focus scope and dismissal.

fixed.summary: Select popup parts retain their markup host's selector attributes and document stylesheet without changing independent popovers. Part inspection includes persistent part boxes.
